summary: Implementation plan to align the Monte Carlo simulation formulas in the A3 Poster and Web App strictly with John Hull Chapter 14 and the lecturer's slides (discrete Euler stepping ΔS = μSΔt + σSε√Δt, Hull Table 14.1 weekly stepping ΔS = 0.00288S + 0.0416Sε, and terminal lognormal distribution), removing Black-Scholes call option pricing formulas.
